channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nickeil Alexander-Walker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nickeil Alexander-Walker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Luguentz Dort on getting traded to the Hawks:

“It's amazing. Obviously, Nickeil [Alexander-Walker] is one of my closest friends. Played on the same team with Nickeil in high school and against him our whole life, obviously. When I got the call and I knew I was heading there, I hit him right away. I was really happy. He's helped me out throughout this whole transition and with their style of play. I'm glad that I got a guy like him on my team now.”

Luguentz Dort on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Sep 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Tim Connelly on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Naz Reid and Julius Randle:

“We’re very appreciative of what the market might look like. We’re pretty cautiously optimistic we’re in a good place with all of the guys. Most importantly, they want to be here.”

Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on playing against his cousin Nickeil Alexander-Walker in the WCF:

“It’ll be very fun. It’s hard to even explain. If you know how close we are. He’s like my second brother. He’s been through every stage of life together. ..it’s very special… But I’m gonna try to take his head off for sure.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, May 18, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
“I figured it out my rookie year, especially when the trade deadline came and they traded (Nickeil Alexander-Walker). He was one of my best friends. I was with him for every road trip, dinner, and all that stuff. The next day he is gone so you kind of get numb to it. It's a part of reality. You just wish the best for the next person.”

Trey Murphy on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Canada’s Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on postgame exchange with Greece after opening win:

“No. 5 bumped Nickeil [Alexander-Walker] after the whistle for no reason. I just wanted to let him know we don’t play that. It was hashed out. It was cool.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Jul 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Jamal Murray on playing against Nickeil Alexander-Walker:

“He's an aggressive defender. It's always competitive. I think that's what I love the most. We can go back and forth, talking, and we know it's all love.”

Jamal Murray on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, May 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Jaden McDaniels on when he plays with Anthony Edwards and Nickeil Alexander-Walker:

“Every time I go on the court and I see them two, I just be like, ‘Who you wanna guard?’ It don’t matter which person we guard. It’s great to have.”

Jaden McDaniels on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Anthony Edwards, Apr 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Zion on valuable contribution from Nickeil Alexander-Walker (20 pts in fill-in start):

“He's always ready when his number is called. He's been in this position before, and he's showed out before. Nickeil doing this, we expect that from him, because we know how great he can be.”

Zion Williamson on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Kira Lewis and Nickeil Alexander-Walker with JJ Redick sidelined:

“Just like with the rest of our team, we want to see them do a good job defensively. They need to bring us a lot of energy. (No) added pressure on them; they're just going to get opportunity.”

Stan Van Gundy on JJ Redick, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Kira Lewis, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
